title: atan2
source_docs: Motor Control Blockset HDL Support/Controls/Math Transforms/atan2.md
text: Compute four-quadrant arctangent, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Approximation method} sets Type of approximation used for atan2 computation; {Output unit} sets the unit of output. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Approximation method
params.values: Type of approximation used for atan2 computation None (default) | CORDIC | Lookup

params.name: Output unit
params.values: Unit of output values Radians (default) | PerUnit
